messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — pushed a tiny docs tweak and addressed the comments from @dan. PTAL when you have a minute. Also bumped the canary timeout to 10m to avoid a transient flake.

dan: Thanks — can you confirm you added the migration note to the changelog and that the flaky e2e is fixed?
alex: Yep, added a bullet under docs/serve/CHANGELOG.md (see commit). E2E flake turned out to be a timing race; I added a retry with backoff in the test harness. Logs: ```2026-03-18 12:34:56 test-retry: passed after 2 attempts```
sam: LGTM on the docs change, left one tiny inline nit about wording. One infra approver needed for the timeout bump though.
infra-bot: Canary slot reserved for 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC by @alex (automated).
maria: I can take a look in ~30–45m and sanity-check the retry/backoff.
maria: Quick follow-up — retry looks good (200ms -> 500ms backoff), I ran the flaky test locally 5x and it passed. Approving from my side.
dan: :thumbsup: thanks. @ops-scheduling can we get a merge custodian after infra gives the green light?
alex: Added labels: ready-for-merge, docs-fixed. PTAL @ops-scheduling — prefer to merge tonight during low traffic.
ops-scheduling: Prefer merge at 03:00 UTC, low usage window. Acknowledged.
alex: Cool — will merge after infra signals OK. Thanks all :party_parrot:
